changes.change: check_01_schema returns N/A only when the tree holds neither a card nor an artifact. With artifacts and no cards it loads the registry and judges the artifacts, as it does now when cards exist. The missing-library PENDING path already covers artifacts.
A tree holding one malformed harness retro and no card, which must fail check 1. Watched accepted with the change absent, and rejected with it.

reach.how_they_learn: The gate itself: a single-group run starts printing check 1 lines it used to skip. This seat tells the harness seats and check 89's holder when it lands.
reach.use_site: check 1, at a run over a tree with artifacts and no cards

notes: A tightening: a tree that passed may now fail. The live repository always holds cards, so no commit's verdict should change; the replay is the builder's to show. Not proposed: validate.py's INCIDENT_ID regex is a fourth copy of the id shape, kept for its named groups and pointed at $defs/incident_id by a comment, with nothing comparing the two. Nothing has drifted, so no incident stands behind it; it is noted in the ledger, not proposed.
